full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media collage places two colorful songbirds close together against an energetic red-pink paper field. The smaller bird at left faces right, with a dark teal head, pale eye stripe, yellow throat, coral-speckled breast, and blue tail. The larger bird at right faces left, its head and back bright turquoise, belly buttery yellow, and wing feathers picked out in repeated blue and pink lines. Their thin dark feet grip a narrow patterned horizontal strip near the lower edge. Behind them, torn rectangles of newspaper, printed pages, stamps, and abstract graphic scraps overlap beneath broad swaths of fluorescent orange, fuchsia, and scarlet paint. Some paper corners remain visible at the upper left and lower right, where tiny text-like marks are present but not legible. Pink droplets, petal-like fragments, rings, and scraping marks add restless movement across the surface. The birds are comparatively naturalistic in proportion but colored beyond realism, with neat contour lines and fine feather hatching. Their clean shapes stand out against the rough, layered, semi-opaque background. Light is even and graphic, with gentle shading beneath wings and on round bodies rather than a distinct directional shadow. The palette turns cool turquoise and cobalt into the main focal contrast against saturated warm magenta and orange. The frame is densely filled, cropped close enough that the right bird nearly meets the side edge. The whole image feels exuberant and handmade, fusing precise avian drawing with torn print, paint, and joyful color collision.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介拼贴把两只彩色鸣禽紧挨着放在充满动势的红粉纸面前。左边较小的鸟向右，有深蓝绿头、淡色眼纹、黄喉、珊瑚点斑胸和蓝尾。右边较大的鸟向左，头与背是鲜绿松石色，腹部奶油黄，翅羽由重复的蓝与粉线挑出。细深脚抓住靠下边的一条窄花纹横带。它们身后，撕开的报纸长方块、印刷页、邮票和抽象图形碎纸重叠，外面刷过荧橙、紫红和猩红的大块颜料。左上与右下仍露出一些纸角，上面有细小类文字痕迹却不可读。粉色飞溅、花瓣般碎片、圆环和刮擦痕给表面添躁动。鸟的比例相对自然，但颜色超越写实，有整齐轮廓与细羽排线。干净鸟形从粗糙、层叠、半不透明背景中跳出。光均匀而图形化，翅下和圆身上只有轻微明暗，没有清楚方向投影。调色让冷绿松石与钴蓝在饱和暖洋红和橙色前成为主要焦点对比。画幅密集填满，裁切近到右鸟几乎接触侧边。整幅图热烈而手作，把精细的鸟类绘图与撕裂印纸、颜料和欢快撞色融合。
style_prompt_en: Mixed-media collage layers torn printed scraps, broad semi-opaque paint swipes, drips, rings, and scratch marks into a saturated field. Hot fuchsia, scarlet, and fluorescent orange fill most of the background, while crisp turquoise, cobalt, and buttery yellow focal shapes provide cool contrast. Clean dark contours and fine directional hatching distinguish the focal forms from ragged paper edges and distressed text-like texture. Overlaps remain visible, giving the flat composition shallow tactile depth. Even graphic light keeps shading modest; energy comes from color collision and varied edge quality. Close cropping and scattered small marks make the square feel exuberant without losing clear large color-mass relationships.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介拼贴把撕裂印刷碎纸、宽阔半不透明刷痕、滴点、圆环和刮擦层叠成饱和色场。热紫红、猩红与荧橙填满大部分背景，清楚的绿松石、钴蓝和奶油黄焦点形体提供冷色对比。干净深轮廓与细定向排线把焦点形体同参差纸边和磨损类文字肌理区分开。重叠保持可见，让平面构图有浅浅的触感纵深。均匀图形光让塑形克制；能量来自撞色和不同边缘质量。贴近裁切与散落细小笔痕使方形热烈，却不失清楚的大色块关系。
theme_en: Two brilliantly colored songbirds over a hot-pink layered paper collage
theme_zh: 两只鲜艳鸣禽立于亮粉色层叠纸拼贴前
name: Vicki Boutin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
